notablePrerequisites:
Undercity Scrounger does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has died this turn.
description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 artifact creature, and therefore dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
